title: 真题演练 · 过去完成时
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 过去完成时。

questions.q: By the time we got home, our mother ___ dinner.
questions.analysis: 做饭先于到家,过去的过去用 had cooked。
说的时候已经丢了,said 是过去参照点,用 had lost。

questions.q: After I ___ my homework, I watched TV.
questions.analysis: 先完成作业再看电视,过去的过去用 had finished。

questions.q: She had never ___ to China before she came here.
questions.analysis: had + 过去分词,be 的过去分词是 been。

questions.q: We ___ English for two years before we went abroad.
questions.analysis: 以 went 为过去参照点,之前持续两年用 had learned。

questions.q: 判断对错:I had saw the movie before.
questions.analysis: 应改为:I had seen the movie before.。过去完成时用过去分词 seen,不是过去式 saw。
